skill_metadata.skill_name: Enrich CBOM with ERP Data (not currently exposed)

isatvon_definition.i_instructions: Registered in system_skills_registry (skill_index 10) but with is_active=false, and NOT present in Standard_BOM_Flow's live routing_sequence -- kept fully working for future use per the MCP server's own module docstring. Action (as implemented): require cbom_db.cbom rows to already exist for this rfq_id (hard ValueError if not); run enrichment.enrich_erp(con, rfq_id), which executes UPDATE statements (queries.erp_enrichment_sql) to fill _erp columns on existing cbom rows from ERP master data. Check: the transaction commits only if no exception is raised. Bound: single attempt, no retry loop. Business rule: independent of enrich_costing_sheet -- either can run, in either order, or be skipped, since both only ever fill their own distinct _erp/_costing columns on the same pre-existing cbom rows.

fresh_state_parameters: cbom_db.cbom rows for this rfq_id -- REQUIRED precondition (enrichment.py's _require_cbom_rows() helper); raises ValueError 'No cbom rows found... call the cbom tool first' otherwise

An ERP master data table (referenced by queries.erp_enrichment_sql(); exact table name not independently confirmed in this pass) -- since no ERP upload path exists in the live product, this table is effectively never populated with real data today

a_automation.orchestration_layer: Not invoked by the live Dify_Dynamic_Master_Router today (excluded from Standard_BOM_Flow's routing_sequence); could be invoked directly via /tool/execute if manually added to a routing_sequence
a_automation.action_step: BEGIN TRANSACTION; enrichment.enrich_erp(con, rfq_id) executes UPDATE statements filling _erp columns; COMMIT on success, ROLLBACK on exception.
a_automation.acceptance_check: No exception raised -- the count of rows with price_original_erp IS NOT NULL (rows_matched_erp) is reported but is NOT itself a pass/fail gate; 0 matched rows is still a 'success' response.
